fusions.name: Sightline
fusions.desc: Fixes on the first enemy in its line and looses a bolt that deals 12 damage and stuns it for 1.2 seconds. Its damage rises 10% for each affliction the target carries, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Stripped by a Look
fusions.desc: Turns the shield's painted eye on everything in a cone 5 tiles ahead, dealing 26 damage that ignores resistance and leaving each enemy [Exposed] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Nothing Unnoticed
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 15% for 10 seconds, and you gain +8% dodge chance.

fusions.name: Seen Once Already
fusions.desc: When a blow lands on you from anything but fire, your critical hit chance rises by 25% for your next strike within 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
